_doc: Arena v3 super-category -> suffix patterns. Suffixes are matched against the END of every discovered Soccer series ticker, so new leagues (EPL, UCL, La Liga, etc.) are automatically included without config changes.

llm_cadence._doc: Design 2: LLM gives per-game priors + may override select legs. Calls restricted to: pregame (priors+overrides), halftime (exit review + 2H reprice), on_demand (material in-play events). Gated by use_llm.

winner._note: match winner (home/draw/away) — any league. Most-traded + most-validated; the lead promotion candidate.

game_lines._note: spread/totals/team-totals/BTTS + 1H + 2H — all leagues. Winner split out into its own category.

game_props._note: correct score + corners + first-to-score — all leagues. Culled by fitness if no edge.

knockout._note: advance/win-method/decide-phase — tournament progression markets. Only active during knockout stages.

player_props._note: stubbed — needs a player data source + per-player model.
